changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.15[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: one sign-in window for every account[/COLOR]
-Linking Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay, WeTrakr, Real-Debrid, Premiumize, AllDebrid or TorBox now opens one window in the same style as the Personal Assistant, instead of a small notification at the top of the screen and a separate dialog with the address and the code.
-Everything is together in that window: a large QR code, the address to open on any device, the code in large type and how long it is still valid, with a bar that runs down.
-When the service puts the code in the link (SIMKL, MDBList, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, and PunchPlay or WeTrakr when they send it), scanning the QR is all it takes, and the window says so.
-Back or Cancel stops the sign-in, also when it was started from Settings.
[COLOR fffdb515]QR codes made on your device[/COLOR]
-QR codes for signing in are now drawn by luc_kodi itself instead of being requested from an outside QR site. Your sign-in code no longer leaves your device to make the picture, and the QR appears even when that site is slow, down or blocked.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt: new sign-in server[/COLOR]
-Trakt is moving every sign-in request to its own server, auth.trakt.tv, and the old address may stop working for them from 1 February 2027. luc_kodi now uses auth.trakt.tv for authorizing, renewing the session and deauthorizing. Your lists, progress, scrobbling and sync are not affected, and your account stays signed in.
-Signing in follows Trakt's current guidance for apps on TVs and media centers: the device code flow, with no secret key sent from your device.
-The QR code opens Trakt's own activation page.
-If auth.trakt.tv cannot be reached from your network, the request is sent once more through the old address until 1 February 2027, only when the first one never left your device.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Trakt: requesting the authorization code no longer sends a token left from an earlier session, and when Trakt refuses it the reason is written to the log.
-Trakt: an unexpected answer while renewing the session is written to the log with Trakt's reason instead of an empty error. Your session is kept and renewing is tried again later.
-Real-Debrid: when the code expired without being approved, the sign-in kept checking forever. It now stops and says the code expired.
-AllDebrid: when the PIN expired or was refused, the authorization dialog stayed open. It now closes.
